curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when a guard's infallible instinct meets the one person who defies it entirely?
curatedMovie.description: A border guard able to identify smugglers meets someone she cannot prove guilty, confronting frightening revelations about herself and humankind.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow-burning, somber, and intensely suspenseful. A heavy, thoughtful watch best suited for solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ali Abbasi blends Nordic crime procedural tension with dark fantasy, creating a deeply original, emotionally weighty investigation into identity.
